text:
pagerbot: ALERT: synthetic-canary-eu-west-1 failed 3/5 checks for route /v1/generate - severity: page

samir (oncall): seeing it too, load looks fine but latency spikes on the canary probe, not yet seeing user-facing errors in dashboards

kevin (sre): copied. any customer 5xxs? lia, can you check support for any recent tickets?

lia (support): 2 customers reported intermittent 504s to /v1/generate between 23:14-23:22 UTC. IPs look to be EU region. I've opened case #2041 and added logs.

samir (oncall): thanks lia. initiating live mitigation: switching traffic route to fallback-model-b1 for EU while we triage.

jen (prod-eng): good call. I'm flipping the routing policy to prefer fallback-model-b1 for 10m. Will post the command.

jen (prod-eng): ```
# promote fallback model for eu
redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate --prefer-model fallback-model-b1 --until +10m
```

kevin (sre): looking at canary metrics, failure pattern is single-step spikes at probe close to 95th pct latency. The probe config is aggressive: freq=30s, timeout=3s, fail_threshold=1. That's noisy for transient GC spikes.

samir (oncall): agreed. current alert triggers on 1 failure -> page. We should avoid paging on single fail. Suggest change: require 3 consecutive fails or increase timeout to 5s, and add a rolling window.

monitoring-bot: current rule: ALERT CanaryEndpointHighLatency
  IF probe_latency_seconds{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu-west-1\"} > 3
  FOR 1m

kevin (sre): propose new rule: ALERT CanaryEndpointHighLatency
  IF increase(probe_latency_seconds{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}[2m]) > 0 OR probe_fail_count{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu-west-1\"} >= 3
  FOR 3m

kevin (sre): will also change probe config: freq 60s -> 45s, timeout 3s -> 5s, consecutive_failures: 3. This reduces noise but keeps sensitivity.

samir (oncall): while kevin updates rules, I'm scaling up dedicated pool in eu-west-1 by +1 GPU to reduce real load risk. Command: `infractl scale pool eu-west-1-dedicated +1`

jen (prod-eng): routing is now on fallback-model-b1. Monitoring: latency on /v1/generate 95th dropped ~40% since switch. Good stopgap.

lia (support): told the two customers they've been moved to fallback model and asked them to reopen if they still see errors.

kevin (sre): patching the alert rule now. adding annotation to avoid pages for low-severity transient ops. I'll push to staging first.

kevin (sre): ```yaml
- alert: CanaryEndpointHighLatency
  expr: probe_fail_count{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu-west-1\"} >= 3 or (
    avg_over_time(probe_latency_seconds{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"eu-west-1\"}[3m]) > 3.5
  )
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood/company/runbooks/canary
```

samir (oncall): nice. can we also create a small dashboard tile that shows consecutive_failures and probe latency distribution (p50/p95/p99) per region? ops wants quick eyeball.

jen (prod-eng): adding grafana panel: "canary-liveness (eu-west-1)" with timeseries for probe_fail_count, probe_latency_seconds:p95, and model_cpu_util. Will reuse existing dashboard "infra/canaries" and add a row.

monitoring-bot: deploy of alert rule to staging started by kevin at 23:30 UTC

kevin (sre): staged rule looks good. no false positives over 1h of backfill. Promoting to prod now.

monitoring-bot: ALERT RULE DEPLOYED to production by kevin at 23:42 UTC

samir (oncall): ok we now have: fallback routing in place, dedicated pool +1, new alert rule (3 fails / 5m), probe freq relaxed -> 45s, timeout -> 5s, grafana panel added.

lia (support): customers notified. ops asked to hold off on wide communications until we confirm if root cause is infra or model change.

kevin (sre): quick RCA notes: root cause likely interplay of a model memory spike during checkpoint compaction (observed on model-b2 variants) coincident with autoscaler oscillation. We're opening a follow-up: engineering to look at model GC and autoscaler hysteresis.

jen (prod-eng): creating ticket ENG-4932 for model GC investigation and ENG-4933 for autoscaler hysteresis tuning. Assigning to model runtime team.

samir (oncall): handing over to kevin for overnight oncall. I'll annotate the incident thread with actions and handoff summary. Kevin, please confirm you accept.

kevin (sre): I accept. Primary oncall: kevin (sre). Accepting handoff at 00:05 UTC.

samir (oncall): handoff notes:
- incident: transient canary failures in eu-west-1 impacting /v1/generate (2 customer 504 reports)
- mitigations: fallback-model-b1 routing (10m), +1 dedicated GPU, alert rule relaxed to 3 consecutive fails / 5m, probe config relaxed (freq 45s, timeout 5s), grafana tile added
- follow-ups: ENG-4932, ENG-4933, support case #2041
- oncall contact: kevin (sre)

kevin (sre): logged handoff ack. I will monitor dashboards and restart probe fleet if we see repeat anomalies. If pages recur, escalate to model runtime @oncall-model.

samir (oncall): thanks team. I'll remain available for 30m via DM. closing page but keeping incident thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
